LanguageData.FTC_AntiTank_Turret.description:
a fixed tank turret mounting on a half-buried concrete box.

As a bunker fortification, the gunner could operate the weapon internally until it was destroyed.

This is a permanent structure, site wisely.
LanguageData.FTC_Batterey_Turret.description:
A heavy navy gun mounted on a large concrete bunker that can effectively destroy enemies within range.

As a permanent fortification, the gunner can safely man the gun inside.

This is a permanent structure, site wisely.
LanguageData.FTC_Wall_Howitzer.description:
a fixed artillery turret mounting on a concrete box.

As a turret fortification, the gunner could operate the weapon internally until it was destroyed, but could not receive direct orders.

This is a permanent structure, site wisely.
